full_prompt_en: A square figurative painting presents an elderly white-bearded man seated close to the viewer and turned toward the right. His large head and shoulders fill most of the frame. Sparse gray hair circles a bald crown; thick brows, a long nose, deeply lined eyes, and a full white mustache and beard establish a weathered, thoughtful face. His eyes look away from the viewer toward a bright opening at the right, while his body remains angled slightly left. He wears a dark charcoal jacket over a brown vest and a deep gray shirt, painted in broad muted folds. A vivid orange-red curved surface sweeps behind his shoulders, separating the dark clothing from a cool sage-green interior. Above and around his head, rounded architectural forms and concave arches flow together like sculpted plaster. At far left, a small arched opening reveals bits of pale masonry and an orange-red hanging object. Another narrow arched view appears behind his profile at right, introducing pale gray light. The composition crops his torso at the lower edge and uses the red curve as a strong diagonal counterweight to his gaze. Warm light from the right models his forehead, nose, cheek, and the fine strands of his beard, while cooler shadows collect around the eyes and neck. The painting surface is grainy and layered, with delicate linework in the face and more simplified passages in coat and background. Earth brown, sage green, slate gray, ivory, and vermilion are balanced throughout. The whole frame feels intimate and contemplative, joining psychological stillness with subtly theatrical color.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形人物绘画呈现一位白须长者近距离坐着，面向右侧。他的大头部与肩膀占据画面大部分。稀疏灰发环绕秃顶；粗眉、长鼻、眼周深纹以及丰满白色胡须和八字髭塑造出饱经风霜、正在思索的脸。他的目光离开观者，望向右侧亮处，而身体略微朝左。身上是深炭色外套、棕色背心与深灰衬衣，衣褶以大块柔和笔触描绘。一道鲜明橙红曲面从肩后扫过，将深色衣物与冷鼠尾草绿色室内分开。头顶与周围，圆润形体和凹拱像雕塑灰泥一样流动相连。最左一处小拱洞露出浅色砌体和橙红悬挂物。人物侧影后右侧还有一道狭窄拱形景，带进浅灰光线。构图在下缘裁去躯干，以红色曲线成为与目光方向相抗衡的强烈斜向力量。右侧暖光塑造额头、鼻子、面颊与细密胡须，眼周和颈部聚集较冷阴影。画面肌理颗粒且层叠，脸部线条精细，外套与背景则更概括。土棕、鼠尾草绿、石板灰、象牙色与朱红在整幅画中平衡。画面亲密而沉思，把心理静止与微妙的戏剧性色彩连在一起。
style_prompt_en: The figurative painted style combines sensitive naturalistic modeling with simplified, gently distorted surrounding shapes. Fine dry-brush lines and translucent color layers articulate close details, while broad matte passages hold larger volumes. Sage green, earth brown, slate gray, ivory, and a decisive orange-red curve create an unusual but balanced palette. Warm directional light picks out raised contours and fine texture; muted cool shadow settles in recesses. Soft arches and sweeping curves interrupt otherwise stable vertical and diagonal masses. The surface has visible pigment grain and slight scumbling, avoiding a polished photographic finish. A close crop and offset gaze create intimacy, while contrasting color bands give the composition energy. Edges vary from delicately drawn to softly fused, directing attention toward the most expressive detail. The overall effect is introspective, textured, and quietly theatrical.
style_prompt_zh: 这种具象绘画风格将敏感的自然主义塑造与简化、略微变形的周围形状结合。细密干笔线条和透明色层刻画近处细节，宽阔哑光笔触则承托较大体积。鼠尾草绿、土棕、石板灰、象牙色与一道果断的橙红曲线形成奇特却平衡的色盘。暖调方向光拣出凸起轮廓与细微肌理，柔和冷影沉入凹处。柔软拱形与横扫曲线打断原本稳定的竖向和斜向大形。表面可见颜料颗粒与轻微干擦，避免抛光照片感。近距离裁切和偏离画面的视线形成亲密感，对比色带又给构图增添能量。边缘从细致勾画到柔和融合不断变化，把注意力导向最有表现力的细节。整体效果内省、有肌理且含蓄戏剧化。
theme_en: An elderly white-bearded man in a dark coat seated against a curving interior
theme_zh: 弧形室内中身穿深衣的白须长者
name: Boris Grigoriev
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
